{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter to only the two channels of interest
channel_subset = sales_df[sales_df['channel'].isin(['email', 'paid_search'])]

# Create age groups
channel_subset['age_group'] = pd.cut(channel_subset['customer_age'], bins=[0, 30, 50, 100], labels=['<30', '30-50', '50+'])

# Define strata: customer_segment and age_group
strata_cols = ['customer_segment', 'age_group']

# Compute conversion rate within each stratum
stratum_rates = channel_subset.groupby(strata_cols + ['channel'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()

# Pivot to have channels as columns
stratum_rates_pivot = stratum_rates.pivot_table(index=strata_cols, columns='channel', values='converted', fill_value=0)

# Compute difference in conversion rates within each stratum
differences = stratum_rates_pivot['email'] - stratum_rates_pivot['paid_search']

# Compute total count in each stratum
stratum_counts = channel_subset.groupby(strata_cols).size()

# Compute weighted average difference (weighted by stratum size)
weighted_diff = (differences * stratum_counts).sum() / stratum_counts.sum()

# Print results
weighted_diff, differences, stratum_counts"}
